title: Marks Above, Below, and Beside the Letter
label: ch:marks-runway
canDo: I can write and name the six Devanagari marks the rest of this book leans on, and say where each one sits relative to its letter.

payoff.summary: Retrieve all six marks cold, by name and by placement, with no model on the page.
payoff.note: The payoff adds no sign; it retrieves every sign the chapter taught, which is what makes it fully representative.
